owner_preference: A named per-device API-style key, created on the Banshee account page from a phone or PC.
scope: Connection proposal only. No native wire, account source, schema, grant, installed service or live capability changes.

personal_access_key.issuer: Banshee accounts, after authenticated account-page approval
personal_access_key.device_label: User-chosen name for identifying and revoking this device's key.
personal_access_key.secret_handling: Show the secret once. The issuer retains only its verifier/hash and non-secret key metadata, never recoverable key plaintext.
personal_access_key.audience: ffxi-forever-companion, matching the existing proposed native companion audience; personal-access-key wire format remains unassigned.
personal_access_key.authority: The server binds the key to the authenticated Banshee subject and an established provisioned native realm/account. It independently checks current entitlement, account status and character ownership for each request. Browser-supplied names, account IDs and character IDs never establish ownership.
personal_access_key.native_format: UNASSIGNED; this proposal chooses no native token format.
personal_access_key.ttl: UNASSIGNED; this proposal chooses no key or child-session lifetime.
personal_access_key.prohibited_reuse: Never derive from or accept launcher sessions, game passwords, FFXI launch tokens, WoW launch grants or social tokens as companion keys.

account_key_issue.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED; issuer route is unassigned
account_key_issue.purpose: Authenticated Banshee account page creates a named per-device companion key and shows its secret once.

anonymous_bootstrap.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED as a real authenticated BFF endpoint
anonymous_bootstrap.purpose: Establish an anonymous same-origin browser session and CSRF bootstrap before key exchange.

request.key: <secret supplied for this initial exchange only>

key_exchange.requirements: Same origin, anonymous session and valid CSRF proof. Validate the companion-only key and current server-side account binding before creating a child session.
key_exchange.success: 204 with an opaque HttpOnly Secure SameSite session cookie; no key or account bearer returned to browser JavaScript.
key_exchange.cookie: NOT IMPLEMENTED; cookie name, SameSite value and lifetime remain unassigned.
key_exchange.ambiguous_result: Do not automatically retry the exchange. Session discovery may establish whether a session exists; never silently resubmit the key.

session_discovery.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED as a real authenticated BFF endpoint
session_discovery.purpose: After the 204, discover the verified session and own selectable characters using the cookie; preserve existing authenticated/realm/csrf_token/characters/capabilities response shapes.

account_key_revoke.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED; revoke route is unassigned
account_key_revoke.purpose: Authenticated account owner revokes a key by its non-secret key ID; its child sessions become invalid.

session_logout.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED as a real BFF endpoint
session_logout.purpose: Revoke the current child session and clear its browser cookie; retain CSRF protection.

session_and_secret_rules: Tie every child session to the key ID and authenticated subject. Enforce key revocation and current entitlement/account/character checks server-side.
Use the key only for initial exchange. Never place it in a URL, browser storage, persisted app settings, logs, analytics or error payloads; discard exchange plaintext after use.
Keep the opaque child-session credential in the HttpOnly cookie, with same-origin and CSRF checks; session discovery does not return it as JSON.
capability_policy: All five existing capabilities remain separately controlled and currently disabled. A valid key or session enables none by itself; actual native providers, engine custody and readiness must be established separately. Real companion rollout follows /fb readiness.

references.finding: Existing device approval yields an ordinary Banshee bearer session; it is the alternative flow, not this proposed key issuer.
/me returns provisioned flags, without native account IDs or owned-character authority.
Existing client token scopes are social.read and social.chat only.
FFXI Forever launch-token serves the native client lock, not companion access.
Current accounts authentication is bearer-based; no companion cookie exchange is present.
Configured shared launch grants build only the WoW forever profile.

source_evidence.absence: Read-only inspection of server.py, identity.py, backends.py and launch_grants.py found no Forever Companion key issuer, audience, exchange, cookie or revoke implementation. This is local source evidence, not installed-service proof.

live_changes: NONE; no key issued, credential read, live call, account/schema/auth change or capability activation.
